title: docs(spec): ban-user and unban-user no longer described as needing the admin plugin
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XmUTbwghz9gpc54Frpqhjn)_

Fixes #34008

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：三处 spec 描述（`authFamilies.admin`、`features.admin`、`plugins.admin`）和 actions 文档示例不再说「停用/恢复用户需要 admin 插件」，引用文档随之重新生成。
- 为什么改：停用/恢复用户的接口早已是平台自带的，不装 admin 插件也能用；旧说法会让 AI 和开发者给这两个按钮错误地加上 admin 门控。
- 风险与回滚：只改文字，没有任何 schema 接受或拒绝的结果变化；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts`、`content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`、`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -n "update-user, ban-user" -- packages/spec/src content/docs` 应无结果。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `AuthFamiliesSchema.admin` describe (`packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts`): the example family member `ban-user` is replaced by `impersonate-user`, and one sentence says `ban-user` and `unban-user` are not in the family: they are ObjectStack mounts, served whatever the flag says. Still one paragraph.
- `features.admin` describe (`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`): "banning" leaves the list of operations that need the plugin; one sentence says banning and unbanning are offered either way.
- `plugins.admin` describe and JSDoc (`packages/spec/src/system/auth-config.zod.ts`): ban / unban leave the list of what the plugin turns on; the JSDoc's endpoint list drops `/admin/ban-user` and `/admin/unban-user` and says they are served with the plugin off as well as on.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`: the `requiresFeature: admin` worked example gates `impersonate_user` (`/api/v1/auth/admin/impersonate-user`) in place of `ban_user`. The second example (`disable_oauth_application`) is unchanged.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/{discovery,protocol,auth-endpoints}.mdx`, `content/docs/references/system/auth-config.mdx` (`check:generated --fix`, which named only `check:docs` stale).
- `.changeset/34008-ban-without-admin-plugin-prose.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`.

## Why

The measurement, on `origin/main` at `27c2f1ea`:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`: `POST {basePath}/admin/ban-user` and `/admin/unban-user` are raw Hono mounts with no admin-plugin condition. Without the plugin, `getBanWriter` writes through the data engine (`isAdminPluginMounted()` false) and the session refusal enforces the ban. `pending-sso-users.test.ts` pins this ("a row banned while the admin plugin was on stays refused after the plugin is turned off", the ban / unban cases with the plugin off, and a CONTROL with it on).
- `sys_user.ban_user` / `unban_user` carry no `requiresFeature`, and `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.admin.gatedInputs` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`) books neither, with a note saying why.
- Routes that still answer 404 when `features.admin` is false: the better-auth vendor routes with no ObjectStack mount: `list-users`, `set-role`, `update-user`, `list-user-sessions`, `revoke-user-session(s)`, `stop-impersonating`, and `impersonate-user` (replaced on the admin plugin's own `endpoints` record by `admin-impersonate-endpoint.ts`, so it exists only with the plugin). The dogfood pin `discovery-auth-families.dogfood.test.ts` reads `GET /auth/admin/list-users` as 404 with the plugin off and not 404 with it on. `sys_user.impersonate_user` declares `requiresFeature: 'admin'`, which is why it is the docs example now.
- ObjectStack mounts such as `create-user` stay mounted without the plugin but answer `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`; the describe's family list does not name them, so this PR does not touch that wording.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` at `36887238`: Test Files 843 passed (843), Tests 26966 passed | 1 todo. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- No test edit was forced. No test pins the old wording (`git grep` of the three old phrases outside `packages/spec/src`, references and CHANGELOGs finds only the two out-of-scope copies listed below).
- No ablation: prose only.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of the card's paths, two copies of a related phrase, not changed here:
  - `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-list.ts:312`, a code comment "Platform admin: ban/unban, set-password, impersonate, set-role." beside the admin plugin's registration. With the plugin on, the vendor's ban hook still enforces, so it is loose rather than false. `domain:server`.
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json` item `identity-auth.admin-lifecycle-operations` title lists ban/unban among "admin user-lifecycle operations"; it makes no plugin claim. `domain:devx`.
- `content/docs/releases/v18/18-5.mdx` and `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` keep their historical wording (release-owned).
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` already says ban / unban answer without `plugins.admin`; unchanged.
- No `skills/**` file teaches the old rule (`git grep -n "ban-user\|ban_user\|unban" -- skills` is empty), so no skills follow-up.
- File surface: the claim names `discovery.zod.ts` and `content/docs/**`; the delta also asks for other `packages/spec/**` copies, which added `auth-endpoints.zod.ts` and `auth-config.zod.ts`.
